verdict.rationale: Wise's own pages say businesses can "Get paid easily in other currencies with global account details" and "Receive payment in 40+ currencies." Community reports confirm users held working USD account details for Wise Business. Those same reports describe the details being changed with zero-day notice, which is an operational caveat rather than evidence the capability doesn't exist. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on which currencies and countries get local account details (the evidence is marketing one-liners), and documented stability or advance notice when account details change.

support.subject: As a founder, I can receive payments using local account details in multiple currencies
